title: Events arrive out of order: a watermark closes a one-minute window, a late event updates it, a very late one goes to a side output
captions: The box is the window for 12:00 to 12:01, by event time. Rides a and b arrive. The watermark (wm) is the newest event time minus 5 seconds: 12:00:35. The count so far is 2.
Ride c happened at 12:00:20 but arrives after b. It is behind the watermark, but its window has not ended, so c still counts. The count is 3. Nothing is sent yet.
Ride d, at 12:01:08, moves the watermark to 12:01:03. That is past the end of the window. The window fires and sends a count of 3.
Ride e happened at 12:00:50 but arrives now. The watermark is past the window's end. With 30 seconds of allowed lateness, the window still accepts it and fires again: 4.
Ride f moves the watermark to 12:01:35. That is past 12:01 plus 30 seconds. The engine deletes the window's state for good.
Ride g, at 12:00:55, arrives even later. Its window is gone. We turned on a side output, so it goes there, where you can log it or fix the count later. Without one, Flink drops it.
